text:
A poem to remember Alice
in the mirror

Here the legendary and the real
Our story resembles

That of the marvelous girl who entered the mirror
She was always on the verge of disappearing

But no one spoke the formula that would return her to dust
Neither Tweedledum nor Tweedledee nor the Queen nor the Red King

Who had only to wake up
Perhaps we are a story

Perhaps without ever realizing it
The ship of Ulysses
Or Keats's nightingale

(That bird not destined for death)
Let us say, then, that what was a canto of the Odyssey

Will continue to be us
While remaining Wonderland

And someone may recognize us
On hearing the story not yet written

In the castle story, the many-mooned story
In the story of a broken toy

The story, at last, of when a cloud passed over Alice
Perhaps we are the shadow of that blue upon her hand

translation.title: Someone Is Saved by Hearing the Nightingale
